claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is compliant because aggregate readiness passed, rollout is staged and reversible, the known emergency-shelter-placement weakness will be explicitly disclosed in the model card, and monitoring will cover the residual risk.
decision_criteria: If the model card already contains explicit pre-launch disclosure of the exposed limitation for the named use case, certification becomes materially better supported.
If approved risk acceptance specifically covering emergency shelter placement exposure exists, that could satisfy the policy alternative to disclosure.
If neither disclosure nor approved risk acceptance exists before launch, certification is noncompliant under the stated policy.
Aggregate readiness, an 8% rollout, and rollback capability support operational caution but do not by themselves satisfy the disclosure policy.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual pre-launch model card or disclosure artifact showing the emergency shelter placement limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide the final certification packet or release record showing the disclosure artifact and monitoring evidence were attached before approval.
Provide either approved risk acceptance covering the exposed segment or confirmation that none exists and disclosure was used instead.
specific_concerns: The affected emergency shelter placement segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The available risk acceptance draft is unsigned and does not address the exposed emergency shelter placement segment.
Policy states rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
No admissible evidence shows the required model-card disclosure was actually completed before launch.
No admissible evidence shows the promised deployment monitoring record or attachment is part of the certification packet.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant on the existing record, rather than only conditionally supportable if disclosure is actually completed and recorded.
That deployment monitoring evidence is attached to the certification record.
That rollout controls materially mitigate the weakness for compliance purposes beyond supporting a limited, monitored launch posture.
